PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and The Republic of Agnolia have entered into a comprehensive agreement of mutual protection and support, pledging to stand together in times of unforeseen crises that may arise. This strategic alliance strengthens the bond between the two nations, fostering a sense of security and cooperation.
PolicyProperties.Title: Alliance with Agnolia

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland wholeheartedly recognizes and affirms the rightful ownership of Heljiland by The Republic of Agnolia. This recognition signifies a diplomatic milestone, solidifying the shared understanding and respect for each other's territorial sovereignty.
PolicyProperties.Title: Recognized Heljiland as Agnolian

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and The Republic of Agnolia have taken a momentous step towards promoting robust economic ties and bolstering bilateral trade by permitting the seamless exchange of capital, goods, and services across their borders and territories. This progressive approach nurtures an environment conducive to economic growth, paving the way for mutually beneficial partnerships.
PolicyProperties.Title: Trade With Agnolia

PolicyProperties.Description: The Alliance of Nations stands as a beacon of global collaboration, tirelessly working to maintain peace, security, and cooperation among nations. Through diplomatic channels and joint initiatives, member countries pool their resources and expertise to address emerging challenges and forge a more harmonious international community.
PolicyProperties.Title: AN Member

PolicyProperties.Description: The Arcasian Treaty Organization (ATO) has emerged as a vital platform uniting nations within its framework, fostering a comprehensive economic and defense alliance. By pooling their strengths and resources, member states of the ATO fortify their collective defense capabilities, creating a united front against potential threats emanating from the CSP.
PolicyProperties.Title: ATO Member

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland's resolute policy of interventionism entails active involvement in countering common enemies within the borders of Wehlen. This proactive approach shows the nation's interest to safeguarding and preserving regional stability through targeted actions against shared adversaries.
PolicyProperties.Title: Interventionism

PolicyProperties.Description: The Contana Security Pact represents a significant stride towards forging an integrated defense strategy and fostering military cohesion among participating nations. Through joint exercises, intelligence sharing, and coordinated operations, member states of the pact enhance their collective ability to defend against potential threats posed by the ATO.
PolicyProperties.Title: CSP Member

PolicyProperties.Description: In accordance with the new emergency decree, which prioritizes national security, Sordland has implemented stringent measures to halt trade, travel, and most diplomatic engagements with Arcasia. This decisive action aims to safeguard the nation's interests and mitigate potential risks arising from the volatile geopolitical landscape.
PolicyProperties.Title: Embargoing Arcasia

PolicyProperties.Description: The new emergency decree mandates a suspension of trade, travel, and most diplomatic relations with Rumburg, underscoring Sordland's commitment to preserving its sovereignty and protecting its national interests amidst evolving regional dynamics.
PolicyProperties.Title: Embargoing Rumburg

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland, in compliance with the new emergency decree, has enacted strict measures to curtail trade, restrict travel, and curtail most diplomatic interactions with the United Contana. This precautionary stance reflects the nation's stance to safeguarding its security and preserving its strategic autonomy.
PolicyProperties.Title: Embargoing United Contana

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and The Republic of Lespia have forged a robust agreement to ensure mutual protection and support in the face of unforeseen crises that may emerge. This strategic partnership reinforces the bond between the two nations, promoting a shared sense of security, stability, and cooperation.
PolicyProperties.Title: Alliance with Lespia

PolicyProperties.Description: Neutrality serves as a cornerstone of Sordland's foreign policy, fostering an approach of non-alignment with any power bloc or alliance. By maintaining a neutral stance, Sordland aims to preserve its autonomy, enhance diplomatic flexibility, and promote peaceful relations with nations across the globe.
PolicyProperties.Title: Neutrality

PolicyProperties.Description: The Organization for Merkopan Economic Cooperation, of which the Republic of Sordland is a member, plays a pivotal role in stimulating economic progress and fostering continental trade. By promoting collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and harmonization of trade policies among member nations, this organization facilitates increased economic integration, trade diversification, and mutually beneficial partnerships.
PolicyProperties.Title: OMEC Member

PolicyProperties.Description: Relaxed immigration laws implemented by the Republic of Sordland streamline and expedite the immigration process, incentivizing individuals from around the world to choose Sordland as their destination. By simplifying visa procedures, reducing bureaucratic hurdles, and offering attractive immigration options, Sordland aims to attract talented professionals, entrepreneurs, and skilled workers who can contribute to its economy, innovation, and cultural diversity.
PolicyProperties.Title: Relaxed Immigration

PolicyProperties.Description: Tighter immigration laws enacted by the Republic of Sordland create a more complex and lengthy immigration process, serving as a deterrent to potential immigrants. These stricter regulations aim to ensure greater scrutiny, security, and control over the entry of individuals into the country. By imposing stricter eligibility criteria, thorough background checks, and additional documentation requirements, Sordland seeks to prioritize national security and protect its domestic job market.
PolicyProperties.Title: Tightened Immigration

PolicyProperties.Description: The Trade Initiative spearheaded by the Republic of Sordland represents a strategic foreign policy move aimed at establishing and strengthening economic partnerships within the region. Through this initiative, Sordland seeks to foster closer economic ties, facilitate trade liberalization, and enhance cooperation on key economic issues such as market access, investment promotion, and harmonization of trade regulations.
PolicyProperties.Title: Trade Initiative

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland and Rumburg have entered into a historic pact aimed at boosting economic relations and fortifying bilateral trade.
PolicyProperties.Title: Trade With Rumburg

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and The Republic of Lespia have entered into a bilateral agreement that permits the exchange of capital, goods, and services across their respective borders or territories. This agreement facilitates trade and economic cooperation between the two nations, creating opportunities for businesses, fostering economic growth, and enhancing bilateral relations.
PolicyProperties.Title: Trade With Lespia

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and The Democratic Republic of Valgsland have established an agreement that facilitates the exchange of capital, goods, and services across their respective borders and territories. This bilateral arrangement enhances economic cooperation and fosters mutually beneficial trade relations between the two nations. By removing barriers to cross-border transactions, such as trade tariffs and import restrictions, Sordland and Valgsland promote seamless economic integration and create opportunities for businesses to thrive.
PolicyProperties.Title: Trade With Valgsland

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and The Democratic Republic of Valgsland have established a mutual protection and support agreement to ensure collective security in times of crisis. By pledging assistance and cooperation, both nations demonstrate their commitment to standing together in the face of unforeseen challenges and threats. This agreement reinforces the bond between Sordland and Valgsland, fostering a sense of trust and solidarity between the two nations.
PolicyProperties.Title: Alliance with Valgsland

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland officially recognizes Heljiland as belonging to The Democratic Republic of Valgsland, affirming their respect for international borders and territorial sovereignty. This recognition strengthens diplomatic relations between Sordland and Valgsland, establishing a foundation of mutual respect and cooperation.
PolicyProperties.Title: Recognized Heljiland as Valgslandian

PolicyProperties.Description: In response to concerns of terrorism, the Republic of Sordland has suspended the entry of all Bludish aliens coming from the Republic of Wehlen. This measure aims to ensure the safety and security of Sordland's borders and its citizens. By temporarily restricting entry from this specific region, Sordland demonstrates its commitment to combating terrorism and protecting national security.
PolicyProperties.Title: Defend Border Against BFF

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and the Republic of Wehlen have forged a cooperative military partnership to coordinate their efforts against the terrorist organization known as BFF. Through joint military operations, information sharing, and coordinated strategies, Sordland and Wehlen aim to counter the threat posed by BFF and maintain regional security.
PolicyProperties.Title: Joint Operation Against BFF

PolicyProperties.Description: The Republic of Sordland and The Republic of Wehlen have entered into a bilateral agreement, allowing for the free exchange of capital, goods, and services across their shared borders and territories. This mutually beneficial arrangement aims to promote economic growth, foster trade partnerships, and strengthen the ties between the two nations.
PolicyProperties.Title: Trade With Wehlen

PolicyProperties.Description: The establishment of a new 30-hectare zone has provided a significant boost to local farmers in Sordland, enabling them to expand their agricultural production and generate a substantial number of job opportunities. This initiative has not only enhanced food security within the country but also contributed to the overall economic development of rural communities. The increased agricultural output has the potential to stimulate the economy, increase export potential, and improve the livelihoods of farmers and their families.
PolicyProperties.Title: Sarna Agricultural Zone

PolicyProperties.Description: The inauguration of the new international airport in Benfi has positioned the city as an exciting travel destination on the global stage. This modern airport facility will not only cater to domestic travelers but also attract international visitors, fostering tourism and opening doors to new economic opportunities. The airport's strategic location and improved connectivity will facilitate easier access to the region, encouraging tourism-related businesses to flourish and boosting the local economy.
PolicyProperties.Title: Benfi International Airport

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland's economic landscape underwent a significant transformation when former President Ewald Alphonso implemented free market reforms, shifting the country from a planned doctrine to a more market-oriented approach. This transition has placed Sordland in a unique position, straddling the realms of two distinct economic systems. The ongoing challenge lies in striking a balance between these ideologies and harnessing the potential benefits while mitigating any adverse consequences.
PolicyProperties.Title: Alphonsonomics

PolicyProperties.Description: The deep integration within the Arcasian Treaty Organization (ATO) has established a mutually beneficial economic dependency among member states. Through close cooperation and coordination, the ATO has facilitated the exchange of goods, services, and capital, fostering increased trade and access to new markets for export. This integration has created a platform for member states to collaborate on economic initiatives, share expertise, and leverage each other's strengths, resulting in enhanced economic growth and development across the region.
PolicyProperties.Title: ATO Economic Area

PolicyProperties.Description: The Central Bank Reinforcement Act aims to enhance the stability of Sordland's national currency and bolster the overall economy. Key measures include the accumulation of foreign exchange reserves for greater currency control, adoption of a prudent fiscal policy to decrease national debt, and targeted support for high-export potential industries to increase international currency demand. This legislation offers a strategic approach to improving economic stability and reinforcing our national currency.
PolicyProperties.Title: Central Bank Reinforcement Act

PolicyProperties.Description: The Contanan Security Pact (CSP) has fostered a deep integration that promotes economic interdependence among member states. By aligning their economic strategies and policies, member states within the CSP have been able to establish an economic framework that facilitates trade, investment, and market access. This integration has opened doors to new goods and markets for export, allowing member states to diversify their economies and expand their economic activities. Through joint efforts and cooperation, the CSP member states have created a supportive environment for economic growth and stability.
PolicyProperties.Title: CSP Economic Area

PolicyProperties.Description: The Energy Inflation Reduction Act targets the recent energy price inflation driven by foreign manipulation in Sordland's energy sector. It proposes a temporary price cap on gas prices, offering immediate relief to citizens, while also advocating for bilateral agreements with energy-rich nations for stable energy supplies. Additionally, the Act highlights the expansion and modernization of domestic energy production as a long-term solution to mitigate external price shocks and stimulate domestic economic growth.
PolicyProperties.Title: Energy Inflation Reduction Act

PolicyProperties.Description: The EPA implemented in 1932, safeguards Sordland's energy industry from excessive foreign ownership. The Act was amended with a return to the Soll-era regulation setting the limit of foreign ownership in national security-sensitive energy corporations at 10 percent.
PolicyProperties.Title: Energy Protection Act at 10 Percent

PolicyProperties.Description: The EPA implemented in 1932, safeguards Sordland's energy industry from excessive foreign ownership. The Act was amended setting the limit of foreign ownership in national security-sensitive energy corporations at 49 percent.
PolicyProperties.Title: Energy Protection Act at 49 Percent

PolicyProperties.Description: The EPA implemented in 1932, safeguards Sordland's energy industry from excessive foreign ownership. The Act was amended in 1949 under the Alphonso government setting the limit of foreign ownership in national security-sensitive energy corporations at 20 percent.
PolicyProperties.Title: Energy Protection Act at 20 Percent

PolicyProperties.Description: The EPA implemented in 1932, that safeguarded Sordland's energy industry from excessive foreign ownership has been removed.
PolicyProperties.Title: Energy Protection Act Removed

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland has implemented robust fiscal protection measures, aimed at safeguarding the national economy against potential shocks and ensuring its long-term sustainability and growth.
PolicyProperties.Title: Fiscal Protection Measures

PolicyProperties.Description: The government of Sordland has undertaken a large-scale investment in Gasom, aiming to bolster the company's operational capacity and stability, thus enhancing the domestic energy sector.
PolicyProperties.Title: Large State Investment in Gasom

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland and Rizia have initiated a co-investment strategy in Gasom, fostering international cooperation while simultaneously strengthening the company's financial position and overall productivity.
PolicyProperties.Title: State Co-Investment in Gasom with Rizia

PolicyProperties.Description: The proposed G.R.E.E.N. Act targets the promotion of sustainable industrial practices, particularly within the Gruni region. This legislation seeks to implement stringent regulations on industrial pollution and waste disposal, with non-compliance resulting in substantial fines, the proceeds from which will fund environmental restoration projects. Simultaneously, the Act encourages environmentally responsible businesses by offering tax incentives and establishing a dedicated fund for eco-friendly practices.
PolicyProperties.Title: Gruni Regeneration and Ecological Economic Nurturing Act

PolicyProperties.Description: The completion of the H-3 Highway, linking Sordland's largest international port in Lachaven with the city of Arvory in Agnland, marks a significant milestone in improving the country's logistical infrastructure. This vital transportation corridor not only enhances the efficiency of goods movement but also facilitates trade and connectivity between regions. The highway serves as a lifeline for economic activities, supporting businesses, industries, and international trade, ultimately contributing to the economic development and integration of Sordland.
PolicyProperties.Title: H-3 Highway

PolicyProperties.Description: In an effort to generate revenue and ensure a fair contribution from the corporate sector, the government has increased the corporation tax rate from 35% to 45% for large private corporations. This move aims to create a more equitable tax system, where businesses bear their fair share of the fiscal burden
PolicyProperties.Title: Tax Increase for Large Corporations

PolicyProperties.Description: Corporation tax in the country has recently been revised, resulting in an increase from 35% to 45% for small and medium businesses. This adjustment aims to ensure a fair and equitable tax system while providing additional revenue for government programs and services.
PolicyProperties.Title: Tax Increase for Small and Medium Businesses

PolicyProperties.Description: To support agricultural entrepreneurs and producers, a program has been introduced that offers financial assistance of up to 10,500 Sordish Ren. In addition to the monetary support, the program includes various forms of assistance such as training, market research, market planning, and equipment reimbursement of up to 70% of the total cost. This comprehensive approach aims to foster the growth and success of the agricultural sector in Sordland.
PolicyProperties.Title: Agricultural Industry Expansion Program

PolicyProperties.Description: With the Automotive Industry Expansion Program, entrepreneurs and aspiring students in the automotive field can benefit from financial aid of up to 10,500 Sordish Ren per person. In addition to monetary support, comprehensive assistance will be provided, encompassing training, materials, manpower, and reimbursement of up to 70% of equipment expenses. This program seeks to stimulate the growth of the automotive industry, encourage technological advancements, and cultivate skilled professionals to meet the evolving needs of the sector.
PolicyProperties.Title: Automotive Industry Expansion Program

PolicyProperties.Description: The Electronics Industry Expansion Program aims to propel the growth of the sector by offering financial support of up to 10,500 Sordish Ren per person to entrepreneurs and aspiring students in the field. Additionally, comprehensive assistance will be provided, including training, access to materials, manpower, and reimbursement of up to 70% of equipment costs. This initiative aims to foster innovation, enhance technical expertise, and drive the development of the electronics industry in Sordland.
PolicyProperties.Title: Electronics Industry Expansion Program

PolicyProperties.Description: The Military Industry Expansion Program aims to bolster the defense sector by providing financial support of up to 10,500 Sordish Ren per person to entrepreneurs and military manufacturers. Alongside monetary assistance, comprehensive support will be extended, including training, materials, manpower, and reimbursement of up to 70% of equipment costs. This program intends to enhance domestic military capabilities, promote technological advancements, and foster a robust defense industry that aligns with national security objectives.
PolicyProperties.Title: Military Industry Expansion Program

PolicyProperties.Description: The construction of a massive industrial city in Conriat serves as a catalyst for diversifying the local economy and boosting industrial production. This development provides opportunities for job creation, technological advancements, and economic growth within the region.
PolicyProperties.Title: Conriat Industrial Zone

PolicyProperties.Description: Section I of L.G.T. sets a 15% tax rate which will be imposed on items of the luxury goods class determined by the Ministry of Economy. This encompasses jewelry, furs, sports cars, yachts, private planes. Section II of the amendment will establish a 10% estate tax for the conditions of purchase, sale and transfer of property in particular in inheritance situations.
PolicyProperties.Title: Luxury Goods Tax

PolicyProperties.Description: In line with the market economy philosophy, Sordland is empowering individual citizens and businesses to make their own economic decisions. This approach entails leaving crucial matters such as the pricing of goods and services to the discretion of market forces and the choices made by consumers and producers. By promoting economic freedom and autonomy, Sordland aims to create a dynamic and competitive marketplace that fosters innovation, efficiency, and responsiveness to the needs and preferences of the Sordish population.
PolicyProperties.Title: Market Economy

PolicyProperties.Description: Private property rights are protected under the government's economic policies, allowing individuals and businesses to exercise a certain level of economic freedom. However, authorities reserve the right to intervene in economic activities when necessary to serve the interests and needs of Sordland.
PolicyProperties.Title: Mixed Economy

PolicyProperties.Description: Adopting a planned economic philosophy, Sordland recognizes the importance of centralized decision-making in shaping the economy of Sordland. Under this framework, the government assumes a prominent role in making most, if not all, significant decisions regarding the production, distribution, and allocation of goods and services. By exerting influence over key economic factors, the country seeks to ensure the equitable distribution of resources, optimize production efficiency, and prioritize collective welfare. Through strategic planning and intervention, Sordland aims to steer the economy towards sustainable growth and address societal needs and priorities.
PolicyProperties.Title: Planned Economy

PolicyProperties.Description: The Morna Port plays a pivotal role as a strategic logistical hub, facilitating increased trade flow to and from the Lorren region. This well-connected port serves as a gateway, connecting Sordland to global markets and contributing to the economic growth and development of the region.
PolicyProperties.Title: Morna Port

PolicyProperties.Description: As part of our economic policy, we are actively promoting a market economy system, encouraging businesses to transition towards this goal. By embracing market principles, such as supply and demand dynamics, fair competition, and private ownership, we aim to create a business environment that fosters innovation, growth, and sustainable economic development.
PolicyProperties.Title: Promote Market Economy

PolicyProperties.Description: In line with our economic vision, we are advocating for a planned economy system, urging businesses to align their operations with this approach. Through comprehensive economic planning and coordinated resource allocation, we aim to optimize productivity, ensure social welfare, and achieve long-term economic stability and growth.
PolicyProperties.Title: Promote Planned Economy

PolicyProperties.Description: The L-1 High-speed Rail represents a significant milestone in transportation infrastructure, being the first electric train line in the country. This modern and efficient rail system connects the cities of Holsord and Lachaven, enabling faster and more convenient commuting options for citizens and enhancing connectivity between these key urban centers.
PolicyProperties.Title: L-1 High-speed Rail

PolicyProperties.Description: To stimulate economic development in the Agnland region, a substantial investment plan has been implemented, providing substantial funds to companies and municipalities. This initiative aims to spur growth, encourage investment, and create opportunities for businesses to thrive, contributing to the overall economic prosperity of the Agnland region.
PolicyProperties.Title: Investment in Agnland

PolicyProperties.Description: A comprehensive investment plan has been initiated to allocate significant funds to companies and municipalities in the Bergia region. This strategic investment aims to stimulate economic development, attract investments, and foster a favorable business climate that will drive growth and enhance the overall economic well-being of the Bergia region.
PolicyProperties.Title: Investment in Bergia

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland's commitment to regional development led to the launch of a substantial investment plan, providing significant funds to companies and municipalities in the Lorren region. This investment initiative seeks to boost economic growth, foster innovation, and support local businesses, thus creating a conducive environment for sustainable development and prosperity in the Lorren region.
PolicyProperties.Title: Investment in Lorren

PolicyProperties.Description: Recognizing the economic challenges faced by the country, the government has taken decisive action by passing a relief act. This comprehensive legislation aims to address the current economic difficulties and provides targeted measures to alleviate financial burdens, support affected sectors, and lay the foundation for a resilient and prosperous economy.
PolicyProperties.Title: Economic Relief Act

PolicyProperties.Description: The initiative is designed to stimulate economic growth, promote innovation, and bolster local businesses. This strategic investment is expected to generate a supportive environment for sustainable development and prosperity in the Gruni region.
PolicyProperties.Title: Investment in Gruni

PolicyProperties.Description: To support and nurture the backbone of the economy, small and medium businesses have been granted a significant tax break. Their tax rate has been reduced from 35% to 25%, providing them with much-needed relief and creating favorable conditions for their growth and development. This measure aims to encourage entrepreneurship, foster innovation, and stimulate economic activity at the grassroots level.
PolicyProperties.Title: Tax Breaks for Small and Medium Businesses

PolicyProperties.Description: In an effort to stimulate economic growth and incentivize investment, large private corporations have been offered an attractive tax break. Their tax rate has been lowered from 35% to 25%, providing them with a favorable business environment to expand their operations, drive innovation, and contribute to the overall prosperity of the country. This policy seeks to attract and retain large-scale enterprises, which play a crucial role in driving economic development and job creation.
PolicyProperties.Title: Tax Breaks for Private Corporations

PolicyProperties.Description: The Sordland Tourism and Cultural Preservation Act aims to enhance the tourism potential of key cities like Borin, Ribery, Lachaven, Anrica, and Benfi to counteract the effects of the recession. The Act focuses on highlighting unique local cultural aspects, restoring significant landmarks, and improving tourist infrastructure. This legislation protects important sites like the Caves of Antera in Ribery and the vineyards of Borin for tourism growth, proposing their safeguarding and development.
PolicyProperties.Title: Tourism and Cultural Preservation Act

PolicyProperties.Description: A new policy has been implemented that allows private corporations to own and operate services within the public infrastructure. This initiative aims to introduce market dynamics and efficiency in sectors such as transportation, enabling private entities to provide essential services while leveraging their expertise and resources. By encouraging private participation in the public infrastructure, this policy strives to enhance service quality, promote competition, and ensure a sustainable and well-functioning system.
PolicyProperties.Title: Transport Infrastructure Privatization

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 5 of the Constitution, an amendment may be proposed by members of the Assembly with at least 150 signatures. A two-thirds majority vote in the Grand National Assembly and a simple majority vote in the Supreme Court is required for the amendment.
PolicyProperties.Title: Constitution Amendments Require Assembly and Supreme Court

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 5 of the Constitution, an amendment may be proposed by members of the Assembly with at least 150 signatures. A two-thirds majority vote in the Grand National Assembly is required for the amendment.
PolicyProperties.Title: Constitution Amendments Require Assembly

PolicyProperties.Description: In a proactive effort to combat government corruption, the Ministry of Justice has introduced an anti-corruption law supported by the establishment of the Anti-Corruption Police. This comprehensive legal initiative aims to address corruption at all levels, ensuring transparency, accountability, and integrity in public office. By actively investigating and prosecuting corrupt practices, this measure seeks to restore public trust, safeguard public resources, and promote a culture of ethical governance.
PolicyProperties.Title: Anti-Corruption Law

PolicyProperties.Description: The region of Bergia is currently structured as an "Autonomous Zone" and has a different governance structure than the rest of the country. It is governed by a regionally elected Bergian Regional Assembly, which is headed by an elected governor. It can pass regional laws and bypass state laws on grounds they do not contradict the Constitution.
PolicyProperties.Title: Autonomous Zone of Bergia

PolicyProperties.Description: Former President, Tarquin Soll, declared the Bludish Freedom Party or BFP to be an illegal criminal organization due to their secessionist activities. Any suspected member of the party shall be arrested without trial. Any event, operation or organization suspected to be colluding with the BFP will be disbanded and its partakers arrested.
PolicyProperties.Title: Bludish Freedom Party Banned

PolicyProperties.Description: To restore order and maintain social stability, an Emergency Decree has been enacted, declaring the Red Youth as an illegal criminal organization. This decree mandates the immediate disbandment of the group and the arrest of all its members. By taking decisive action against such organizations, the authorities aim to eliminate threats to public safety, deter unlawful activities, and uphold the rule of law.
PolicyProperties.Title: Red Youth Banned

PolicyProperties.Description: In response to the need for restoring order and safeguarding the integrity of the state, the Emergency Decree has declared the Worker's Party of Bludia (WPB) as an illegal criminal organization. This decree orders the immediate disbandment of the party and the arrest of all its members. By dismantling this organization, the authorities aim to neutralize its potentially disruptive activities, ensure public safety, and protect the nation's interests.
PolicyProperties.Title: Worker's Party of Bludia Banned

PolicyProperties.Description: To address threats to public safety and maintain social order, the Emergency Decree has deemed the Young Sords as an illegal criminal organization. This decree mandates the immediate dissolution of the group and the apprehension of all its members. By taking swift action against such organizations, the authorities aim to preserve peace, protect the welfare of citizens, and uphold the principles of justice.
PolicyProperties.Title: Young Sords Banned

PolicyProperties.Description: The Ministry of Justice and its vital subsidiary institutions have experienced a decrease in their allocated funds. This reduction in budgetary resources presents challenges in maintaining the necessary levels of efficiency and effectiveness in delivering justice services. Efforts will be made to optimize available resources and prioritize essential functions to ensure the continued operation of the justice system.
PolicyProperties.Title: Decreased Justice Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 18 and 51, the President may issue decrees on political, social, and economic issues that would carry the force of law. However, they could not contradict the constitution and are subject to judicial review. The Assembly may pass legislation on the same subjects to override presidential decrees.
PolicyProperties.Title: Presidential Decrees

PolicyProperties.Description: In accordance with the new Constitution, Article 18 has been amended, removing the President's power to issue decrees with the force of law. This revision seeks to enhance checks and balances within the governmental structure, ensuring that legislation is enacted through appropriate channels and in alignment with democratic principles.
PolicyProperties.Title: Presidential Decrees Removed

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 18 and 51 of the new Constitution, The jurisdiction of the presidential decrees will have priority over statute laws made by the Grand National Assembly. The presidential decrees may not be subject to judicial review.
PolicyProperties.Title: Stronger Presidential Decrees

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 18 and 51 of the new Constitution, The President will not be able to issue decrees that would carry the force of law without an enabling act from the Grand National Assembly.
PolicyProperties.Title: Presidential Decrees Require Enabling Act

PolicyProperties.Description: Section I enforces that the educational institutions of Sordland will teach all classes, except for foreign languages, in the official language of the country, unless they are given specific approval by the Ministry of Education. Universities, technical colleges, and other schools that provide classes in any language other than Sordish will receive a suspension of operations until they apply for the approval process. Section II enforces the law through defunding penalties or total shutdowns of schools.
PolicyProperties.Title: Education Unification Act

PolicyProperties.Description: A new bill has been passed into law, significantly altering the criteria for the allocation of public funds to political parties. Under the revised guidelines, the distribution of funds will no longer be based on the number of votes obtained by a political party in the general election. Instead, the criteria will now consider the proportion of seats won by a party in the Assembly. As a result of this change, political parties will receive an annual amount of 500,000 ren per Member of Assembly. This adjustment leads to a doubling of the election budget for the party with the highest seat count (USP) and a slight increase for other parties in the Assembly. However, it also means that parties falling below the 10% election threshold will no longer receive any public funding. This modification aims to align the distribution of funds with the representation of parties in the Assembly, ensuring a more proportional allocation of resources based on political success.
PolicyProperties.Title: Electoral Funding Reform

PolicyProperties.Description: In response to the need for restoring order and ensuring public safety, a new emergency decree has been enacted, granting the state extensive powers. This measure enables the authorities to take swift and effective action in critical situations, safeguarding the well-being of citizens, and maintaining social stability.
PolicyProperties.Title: Emergency Decree

PolicyProperties.Description: Under the new Constitution, Article 99, which previously defined the "Member of Honor" title, has been removed. This revision reflects a shift in the constitutional framework, emphasizing equal treatment and opportunities for all former Presidents who hold the title.
PolicyProperties.Title: Honorary Membership Abolished

PolicyProperties.Description: Article 99 of the new Constitution defines the “Member of Honor” title, its appointment procedure as well as the rights their members may exercise. A Member of Honor has absolute immunity and is a permanent member of the Grand National Assembly. He/She is entitled to his/her security team, provided by the State’s Presidential Guards. A member is also eligible to live in a special private residence provided by the State for free. The only Member of Honor is Tarquin Soll.
PolicyProperties.Title: Honorary Membership

PolicyProperties.Description: Article 99 of the new Constitution defines the “Member of Honor” title, its appointment procedure as well as the rights their members may exercise. A Member of Honor is a permanent member of the Grand National Assembly. He/She is entitled to his/her security team, provided by the State’s Presidential Guards. A member is also eligible to live in a special private residence provided by the State for free. The position no longer gives the holder absolute immunity.
PolicyProperties.Title: Immunity of Honorary Members Removed

PolicyProperties.Description: Article 99 of the new Constitution defines the “Member of Honor” title, its appointment procedure as well as the rights their members may exercise. A Member of Honor has absolute immunity and is a permanent member of the Grand National Assembly. He/She is entitled to his/her security team, provided by the State’s Presidential Guards. A member is also eligible to live in a special private residence provided by the State for free. Every President of Sordland becomes a Member of Honor immediately after their term as president is over.
PolicyProperties.Title: Honorary Membership For All Presidents

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 17 of the new Constitution, the President of Sordland is not responsible for the actions performed in the exercise of presidential duties, except in the case of high treason or violation of the Constitution. In such cases, The President may be impeached with a two-thirds majority vote in the Grand National Assembly.
PolicyProperties.Title: President Impeachable By The Assembly

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 17 of the new Constitution, the President of Sordland is not responsible for the actions performed in the exercise of presidential duties, except in the case of high treason or violation of the Constitution. In such cases, the President may be impeached by the Supreme Court in a joint session, with an absolute majority of its members.
PolicyProperties.Title: President Impeachable By The Court

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 17, the President of Sordland is not responsible for the actions performed in the exercise of presidential duties, except in the case of high treason or violation of the Constitution. In such cases, The President may be impeached with a two-thirds majority vote in both the Grand National Assembly and the Supreme Court.
PolicyProperties.Title: President Impeachable By The Court And The Assembly

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 17 of the Constitution, the President is exempt from any responsibility for actions carried out in the course of presidential duties. This provision ensures that the President can fulfill their role without personal liability for decisions made in their official capacity.
PolicyProperties.Title: Presidential Immunity

PolicyProperties.Description: The budget allocated to the Ministry of Justice and its essential subsidiary institutions has experienced a significant increase. This additional funding aims to strengthen the resources and capabilities of the justice system, enabling it to effectively carry out its duties and uphold the rule of law.
PolicyProperties.Title: Increased Justice Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: The Supreme Court Justices may face impeachment proceedings if there are grounds to suggest unconstitutional behavior. To initiate an impeachment, a valid proposal must secure a two-thirds majority decision from the Grand National Assembly. This process ensures accountability and integrity within the judicial branch.
PolicyProperties.Title: Justices Impeachable By Assembly

PolicyProperties.Description: The Justices of the Supreme Court are not held individually responsible for the actions performed in the exercise of their duties. This principle safeguards their independence and shields them from personal liability while upholding the impartiality of their judicial decision-making.
PolicyProperties.Title: Immunity of Justices

PolicyProperties.Description: As per the authority vested in the President of Sordland, they possess the power to replace a Justice of the Supreme Court with another qualified individual. This mechanism allows the President to shape the composition of the court and maintain a functioning judiciary.
PolicyProperties.Title: Justices Impeachable By The President

PolicyProperties.Description: The Grand National Assembly holds the authority to nominate a list of ministers, which the President may appoint to the executive branch. This collaborative process ensures a diverse representation of expertise and perspectives in the Council of Ministers.
PolicyProperties.Title: Ministers Proposed By The Assembly

PolicyProperties.Description: The President has the prerogative to nominate ministers for appointment. However, the confidence of the Grand National Assembly is required through a vote to confirm their appointment. This parliamentary approval mechanism ensures accountability and legitimacy in the executive branch.
PolicyProperties.Title: Appointment Of Ministers Required The Assembly

PolicyProperties.Description: The President appoints ministers to the Council of Ministers from among the elected members of the Assembly. This process fosters political inclusiveness and allows for representation from various parties in the executive decision-making process.
PolicyProperties.Title: Ministers Chosen From The Assembly

PolicyProperties.Description: Section I of the new legislation establishes a minority rights commission dedicated to advocating for the rights of all minority groups residing in Sordland. In Section II, the ban on the Bludish Freedom Party and other Bludish political parties is lifted, promoting political inclusivity. Section III grants amnesty to Bludish prisoners previously arrested for their separatist activities, aiming to foster reconciliation and social cohesion.
PolicyProperties.Title: Minority Rights Act

PolicyProperties.Description: The newly proposed bill will amend section III of the 1923 Legal Transactions Act that allowed the legalization of transactions that occur in non-registered businesses or other entities like a single person's if the parties delivered accurate documentation to the financial authority. This created a legal loophole for prostitution. The Human Dignity Bill will protect common decency and prevent the violation of moral principles that occur in the act of prostitution by making it an illegal offense in which perpetrators are punishable by law.
PolicyProperties.Title: Human Dignity Acts

PolicyProperties.Description: The assembly in cooperation with the Commission on the Status of Women has concluded that the country suffers from a high ratio of domestic violence cases. In light of these immoral conditions, the parliament passes the following law. Section I criminalizes domestic violence that occurs against women. Subsection I of Section I gives state protection to abused women.
PolicyProperties.Title: Women Protection Act

PolicyProperties.Description: A reform committee has been convened to engage in extensive discussions on the potential revisions and updates to the constitution. This inclusive dialogue involves representatives from all political parties within the government, providing an opportunity for comprehensive constitutional review and reform.
PolicyProperties.Title: Reform Committee

PolicyProperties.Description: For the purposes of increasing religious harmony and unity, the following laws are established in religious affairs: The Day of Descension ceremony in the Arch-sanctuary of Deyr shall from now on only hold sermons in the Sordish language. The majority of Bludish cities, towns, and villages with sanctuaries shall not be allowed to hold sermons in Bludish unless they receive approval from the Archpriest of Sordland. All priests applying to be state-sanctioned must have Sordish descendants in majority Bludish population zones to be able to receive their salaries and pensions.
PolicyProperties.Title: Religious Harmony Bill

PolicyProperties.Description: The term "Sord" is removed from the Constitution and is replaced by "citizen of Sordland". Article 7 is amended to: "Everyone; regardless of language, race, color, gender, political thought, philosophical belief, religion or disability are equal before the law."
PolicyProperties.Title: Article 6 & 7 Amended

PolicyProperties.Description: Article 6 of the Sordish Constitution identifies all citizens as 'Sords,' irrespective of their ethnicities or cultures. Article 7 states that every Sord is equal before the law, implying equal rights and responsibilities for all citizens.
PolicyProperties.Title: Article 6 & 7

PolicyProperties.Description: The region of Bergia is currently structured as a "Special Zone" and has a different governance structure than the rest of the country. Established by Tarquin Soll after the bloody revolts of the separationists, the Special Zone was aimed to eliminate the security threats in the region and to maintain peace. There are no municipal elections within the Special Zone and the region is governed by a governor with expanded powers from the city of Deyr -- who is usually appointed by the president. Special Zone has its own security forces and is not in the jurisdiction of the Interior Ministry.
PolicyProperties.Title: Special Zone of Bergia

PolicyProperties.Description: The President's stability decree has led to the immediate prohibition of criminal political organizations. This decisive measure aims to restore stability and safeguard the democratic processes in Sordland by dismantling groups that pose a threat to the country's security and well-being.
PolicyProperties.Title: Stability Decree of 1954

PolicyProperties.Description: According to the new Constitution, the President is limited to serving a maximum of two terms. This provision ensures the rotation of power, fosters democratic principles, and prevents the consolidation of authority in a single individual.
PolicyProperties.Title: Two Term Limit

PolicyProperties.Description: According to the Constitution of Sordland, there are no limitations on the number of terms the President can serve. This provision allows for the possibility of the President being elected and reelected for consecutive terms without any restrictions or term limits. The absence of term limits provides stability in leadership and continuity in governance, allowing the President to potentially serve an unlimited number of terms if reelected by the electorate.
PolicyProperties.Title: Unlimited Terms

PolicyProperties.Description: As outlined in Article 50 of the new Constitution, a political party must obtain at least 15% of the total national vote to secure seats in the Grand National Assembly. The proportional redistribution of votes ensures fair representation and inclusivity in the legislative process.
PolicyProperties.Title: Election Threshold of 15%

PolicyProperties.Description: In accordance with Article 50 of the new Constitution, a political party must secure a minimum of 3% of the total national vote to be eligible for seats in the Grand National Assembly. The votes of parties that surpass this threshold are redistributed proportionally, guaranteeing fair representation and inclusivity in the legislative body.
PolicyProperties.Title: Election Threshold of 3%

PolicyProperties.Description: In line with Article 50 of the new Constitution, a political party requires a minimum of 8% of the total national vote to earn seats in the Grand National Assembly. Votes exceeding this threshold are redistributed proportionally, ensuring an equitable distribution of representation in the legislative body.
PolicyProperties.Title: Election Threshold of 8%

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 50 of the new Constitution, a political party needs a minimum of 10% of the total national vote to win seats in the Grand National Assembly. The votes of the parties who pass the threshold are re-distributed proportionally.
PolicyProperties.Title: Election Threshold of 10%

PolicyProperties.Description: Article 77 and 82 of the new Constitution grant the President the authority to veto a bill by returning it to the Assembly with a written statement. This veto power serves as a check and balance mechanism, allowing the President to express concerns and initiate further deliberations on proposed legislation.
PolicyProperties.Title: The President May Veto Bills

PolicyProperties.Description: According to Article 77 and 82 of the new Constitution, the Grand National Assembly holds the power to overrule a veto with a 66% majority decision. This parliamentary override mechanism ensures that the legislative branch can proceed with enacting a bill, even in the face of presidential opposition.
PolicyProperties.Title: Presidential Vetoes Can Be Overruled

PolicyProperties.Description: The new Constitution grants the Grand National Assembly the ability to override a veto with a supermajority. However, the President retains the discretion to act on the bill at their own discretion, allowing for further dialogue and negotiation between the executive and legislative branches.
PolicyProperties.Title: Pocket Veto

PolicyProperties.Description: Article 77 of the new Constitution prohibits the President from vetoing any bill, and all bills that meet the judicial requirements will automatically become law. This provision streamlines the legislative process and eliminates the potential for a presidential veto to impede the enactment of legislation.
PolicyProperties.Title: Veto Removed

PolicyProperties.Description: The assembly in cooperation with the Commission on the Status of Women passes the following laws. Section I criminalizes domestic violence that occurs against women. Subsection I of Section I gives state protection to abused women. Section II enforces equal pay for women in the workplace and disallows companies from paying less or more for the same job position. Section III affirms that the education system should provide equal treatment to both genders. Section IV enacts paid maternity leave and state-subsidized day care centers for mothers.
PolicyProperties.Title: Women's Liberation Act

PolicyProperties.Description: The administration has successfully passed a comprehensive labor rights reform, introducing significant improvements to the working conditions of employees. These reforms aim to safeguard workers' rights, promote fair treatment, and enhance workplace environments for the betterment of the labor force.
PolicyProperties.Title: Workers Rights Reform

PolicyProperties.Description: The Sordish Air Force extends its hospitality and support to the Arcasian 4th Fighter Squadron, allowing them to refuel, undergo necessary repairs, and access the state-of-the-art facilities at the Erlory Air Force Base. This collaborative effort enhances the intermingling of expertise, resources, and shared knowledge between the two air forces, fostering stronger cooperation and mutual support.
PolicyProperties.Title: Arcasia given Air Base Access

PolicyProperties.Description: ATO Officers engage in close partnership with Sordish generals, diligently exchanging and imparting their contemporary strategies, innovative tactics, and specialized training to the Sordish Soldiers. This collaborative endeavor serves to fortify the skills and proficiency of the Sordish Military, enabling them to adapt and thrive in ever-evolving operational environments.
PolicyProperties.Title: ATO Officers

PolicyProperties.Description: In Sordland, the military operates as a conscripted force, where the duty of military service falls upon males upon reaching the age of 18. This mandatory conscription ensures a consistent and capable pool of personnel to uphold the nation's defense and security, strengthening the overall resilience and readiness of the military.
PolicyProperties.Title: Compulsory Military Service

PolicyProperties.Description: CSP Officers actively collaborate with Sordish generals, forging strong bonds as they share cutting-edge strategies, tactics, and training methodologies with the Sordish Soldiers. This exchange of knowledge and expertise enriches the Sordish Military's repertoire, empowering them to tackle diverse challenges with skill and confidence.
PolicyProperties.Title: CSP Officers

PolicyProperties.Description: The budget allocated to the Sordish Military has experienced a decrease, prompting a comprehensive assessment of the financial framework that supports the military's operations. This adjustment in funding may impact the allocation of resources, potentially requiring strategic optimizations to maintain the structural integrity and operational efficiency of the military.
PolicyProperties.Title: Decreased Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: A forward-thinking and comprehensive expansion plan has been meticulously devised to augment the force size of a particular military branch. This ambitious initiative aims to bolster the military's capabilities, ensuring it remains equipped, adequately staffed, and sufficiently prepared to fulfill its multifaceted responsibilities with utmost effectiveness.
PolicyProperties.Title: Expansion Programme

PolicyProperties.Description: The Gendarmerie, an esteemed armed law enforcement organization, stands as a bulwark in preserving security and public order, with a primary focus on rural security. Furthermore, the Gendarmerie's versatility allows it to be flexibly deployed to assist cities under the guidance and request of mayors, fortifying law enforcement capabilities and fostering safer environments for all.
PolicyProperties.Title: Gendarmerie under Defense

PolicyProperties.Description: The budget allocated to the Sordish Military has been thoughtfully increased, affording new opportunities and augmenting resources available to strengthen the military's overall capabilities. This boost in funding opens avenues for innovative investments, equipment upgrades, and personnel development, bolstering the military's preparedness and enhancing its ability to meet evolving security challenges.
PolicyProperties.Title: Increased Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: The Sordish Armed Forces have embarked on a series of joint military exercises with their esteemed allies, aiming to enhance military coordination, interoperability, and synergy. Through these collaborative drills, the Sordish Armed Forces seek to improve their strategic alignment and tactical cooperation with allied forces, fostering a more cohesive and effective defense network.
PolicyProperties.Title: Joint Military Exercises

PolicyProperties.Description: A comprehensive modernization plan has been strategically devised to revitalize and upgrade the equipment used by a specific military branch. This ambitious initiative entails the integration of advanced technologies, the procurement of state-of-the-art weaponry, and the implementation of cutting-edge systems, thereby bolstering the military's combat capabilities and enabling it to adapt to emerging threats.
PolicyProperties.Title: Modernisation Programme

PolicyProperties.Description: The Sordish General Staff, comprising esteemed and seasoned generals, serves as a pivotal military planning body. This esteemed assembly of top-ranking officers engages in meticulous strategizing and coordination to develop comprehensive plans and strategies that optimize the military's operational efficacy and ensure the successful execution of defense objectives.
PolicyProperties.Title: Sordish General Staff

PolicyProperties.Description: The Sordish Navy extends its facilities and support to the United Contanan Markian Sea Fleet, facilitating their refueling operations and essential repairs at the esteemed Conriat Naval Base. This collaborative effort fosters inter-naval cooperation, promotes mutual trust, and strengthens regional security in the vital maritime domain.
PolicyProperties.Title: United Contana given Naval Base Access

PolicyProperties.Description: The Anti-Corruption Police, operating under the jurisdiction of the esteemed Ministry of Justice, assumes a pivotal role in combating government corruption and upholding the principles of integrity and accountability. This specialized police force is dedicated to investigating and addressing instances of corruption, ensuring transparency and the rule of law within the governance framework.
PolicyProperties.Title: Anti-Corruption Police

PolicyProperties.Description: The Police, entrusted with the responsibility of maintaining law and order, possess specific powers related to the use of force, orders for confiscations, and the right to stop and frisk. However, these powers are permissible within the legal boundaries prescribed by law, ensuring that the protection and safety of individuals are upheld while maintaining the integrity of due process.
PolicyProperties.Title: Increased Police Authority

PolicyProperties.Description: The Community Police, an exemplary neighborhood initiative, fosters trust and collaboration by bringing law enforcement officers closer to communities through the active participation of trusted local citizens. This grassroots approach ensures a more nuanced understanding of community needs, strengthens relationships, and enhances the overall efficacy of law enforcement in addressing local concerns.
PolicyProperties.Title: Community Police

PolicyProperties.Description: The government has authorized the Ministry of Interior to plan and execute an internal counter-terrorism operation against the Bludish Freedom Front with the aim of destroying their infrastructure and eliminating the entirety of its leadership.
PolicyProperties.Title: Counter-Terrorism Operation Against BFF

PolicyProperties.Description: Recent incidents of civil unrest have necessitated the implementation of proactive crowd control measures aimed at preventing further escalation and maintaining public safety. These carefully devised measures ensure the preservation of order, the protection of public and private property, and the safety of all individuals involved.
PolicyProperties.Title: Crowd Control Measures

PolicyProperties.Description: The Ministry of Interior, responsible for maintaining law enforcement capabilities, has encountered a reduction in funding. This financial adjustment poses challenges to the optimal functioning and effectiveness of law enforcement agencies, necessitating strategic realignments and the prioritization of resources to ensure the continued protection of the nation and its citizens.
PolicyProperties.Title: Decreased Interior Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: Based on strong indications and under specific circumstances, if an individual is suspected of committing crimes against internal and external security, they may be subject to proposed detention until further notice, even in the absence of sufficient incriminating evidence. This exceptional measure seeks to prevent potential threats to national security while ensuring that due process and fundamental rights are respected.
PolicyProperties.Title: Detention Without Trial

PolicyProperties.Description: Under the directive of the President, the Ministry of Interior has undertaken measures to restore order and security by reducing training times and expanding the law enforcement force. This concerted effort aims to strengthen law enforcement capabilities, enhance response times, and ensure the safety and well-being of the nation and its inhabitants.
PolicyProperties.Title: Emergency Police Expansion

PolicyProperties.Description: The prevailing conditions of peace and security in Sordland have prompted the majority of the Grand National Assembly to advocate for a reduction in security laws. Section I of The Freedoms Act revokes the provision for 48-hour detention without trial, safeguarding the principle of fair and timely justice. Section II modifies the requirements for warrant requests concerning investigations of private property, now necessitating approval from a judge within the local jurisdiction rather than the district police chief. Section III abolishes the practice of stop and frisk entirely, preserving the rights and dignity of individuals. Section IV establishes strict guidelines stipulating that the use of force is permissible only as an absolute last resort, ensuring the protection of lives and the preservation of peace.
PolicyProperties.Title: Freedom Act

PolicyProperties.Description: The Gendarmerie, an esteemed armed law enforcement organization, plays a crucial role in maintaining security and public order. While its primary focus is on rural security, the Gendarmerie possesses the capacity to be deployed at the request of mayors, offering support to ensure the safety and well-being of urban areas.
PolicyProperties.Title: Gendarmerie under Interior

PolicyProperties.Description: The Ministry of Interior has witnessed an increase in funding, facilitating improved law enforcement activities and empowering the law enforcement agencies to carry out their duties more effectively. This financial boost allows for enhanced training, increased resources, and improved infrastructure, ensuring a stronger and more responsive law enforcement presence.
PolicyProperties.Title: Increased Interior Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: In Sordland, private prisons have been authorized to be established by private investors, subject to meeting stringent criteria for security and living standards. This initiative aims to diversify the corrections system while upholding the principles of safety, security, and humane treatment within these privately operated facilities.
PolicyProperties.Title: Private Prisons

PolicyProperties.Description: The Secret State Police, a covert government entity, wields the authority to monitor, apprehend, and prosecute individuals deemed necessary by the state. This secretive force operates with a mandate to protect national security and public order, employing covert techniques and procedures to safeguard the nation's interests.
PolicyProperties.Title: Secret State Police

PolicyProperties.Description: The prevailing lack of security resulting from a period of social upheaval necessitates the implementation of stringent measures proposed by the majority of the Grand National Assembly. Section I of the S.A. empowers security forces to employ the use of force when deemed necessary to maintain public safety and restore order. Section II grants authorization for suspicion-based arrests and confiscations without the need for warrants, allowing for swift action in urgent situations. Section III expands the authority of security forces, permitting them to operate beyond the legal limits in order to ensure the preservation of state security and the well-being of the general public.
PolicyProperties.Title: Security Act

PolicyProperties.Description: Members of the security apparatus in Sordland enjoy privileges and benefits that extend beyond those available to the general population. These special provisions reflect the unique nature of their responsibilities and the crucial role they play in safeguarding the nation's security and stability.
PolicyProperties.Title: State Security Privileges

PolicyProperties.Description: The right to peaceful protests will be temporarily suspended, with corresponding restrictions imposed on the freedom to assemble, organize, and express oneself. These measures aim to mitigate potential risks, maintain public safety, and restore social order, striking a balance between individual rights and the collective well-being of the nation.
PolicyProperties.Title: Suspension of Protests

PolicyProperties.Description: Education funding has experienced a significant decrease, which has had a profound impact on the already underfunded education system. This reduction in financial resources has further exacerbated the challenges faced by educational institutions and limited opportunities for students. The decrease in the healthcare budget has also had a significant impact, leading to a noticeable decline in the quality of healthcare services being provided. The strain on the healthcare system has intensified, compromising the level of care available to the population.
PolicyProperties.Title: Decreased Education Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: The healthcare budget has significantly decreased, leading to worsening services provided. This has resulted in limitations in care, longer waiting times, and reduced access to specialized treatments. Despite these challenges, healthcare professionals are striving to deliver quality care. Efforts are being made to optimize resource utilization, explore alternative funding sources, and advocate for increased healthcare funding.
PolicyProperties.Title: Decreased Health Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: In an effort to address funding challenges and augment resources, the government has introduced an education privatization plan. This plan allows private interests to participate in the education sector by either purchasing or building educational institutions. The aim is to attract additional funding and investment to support the education system and improve its overall quality.
PolicyProperties.Title: Education Privatization

PolicyProperties.Description: Responding to societal concerns, the government of Sordland has taken steps to remove nationalistic indoctrination from the education system. This move reflects a shift towards fostering free thought and critical thinking among students. By instilling an environment that encourages independent thinking, the government aims to promote intellectual exploration and create a more inclusive educational atmosphere.
PolicyProperties.Title: Education Reform

PolicyProperties.Description: Due to a health emergency, the authorities have initiated an epidemic prevention plan, diverting all available resources towards containment measures. This comprehensive plan is designed to effectively address the health crisis and mitigate the further spread of the epidemic within the country. The plan reflects a proactive approach to safeguarding public health and well-being.
PolicyProperties.Title: Epidemic Prevention Measures

PolicyProperties.Description: To support the social benefits initiative, the Grand National Assembly (GNA) has approved the Emergency Assistance Bill (E.A.B.). Section I of the bill introduces amendments to the compensatory veterans and state employees' disability benefits program, expanding its provisions to include an earnings replacement benefit for all non-state employed citizens. Under this newly expanded program, individuals who experience severe illness or disability, rendering them unable to work, will receive a steady income from the state equivalent to 50% of their monthly salary. This provision aims to provide support and financial stability to those facing challenging circumstances.
PolicyProperties.Title: Equal Ability Bill

PolicyProperties.Description: Religious classes within educational institutes exclusively focus on teaching evolution as a scientifically accepted fact of life, shaping the perspectives of attending students. In alignment with scientific consensus, the new law bans the teaching of Creationism doctrines in all educational institutes. Schools or universities found in violation of this law will face closure. Additionally, the law mandates the inclusion of Evolution doctrines as a compulsory subject, requiring educational instructors to hold certification in Evolution subjects to qualify for their teaching positions. These measures promote scientific understanding and critical thinking among students.
PolicyProperties.Title: Evolution Taught

PolicyProperties.Description: Under the new law, Creationism doctrines are banned from all educational institutes. Any schools or universities that are caught teaching creationism, from the moment this law is passed, will be closed. Furthermore, Evolution doctrines will be mandatory. Every educational instructor is required to have a certification under Evolution subjects to qualify for the job.
PolicyProperties.Title: Evolutionary Education

PolicyProperties.Description: Under the new law, Creationism doctrines are optional from all educational institutes. However, Evolution doctrines must be mandatory. Every educational instructor is required to have a certification under Evolution subjects to qualify for the job.
PolicyProperties.Title: Evolutionary Education with Creationism

PolicyProperties.Description: Under the law, educational institutes are granted the freedom to teach Creationism or Evolution as part of their curriculum. This ensures that schools have the autonomy to choose the approach that aligns with their educational philosophy. It allows for a diverse range of perspectives and encourages critical thinking among students. The law acknowledges the importance of academic freedom and respects the rights of educational institutions to shape their curriculum according to their values and beliefs. By providing this flexibility, the law promotes a balanced and inclusive learning environment.
PolicyProperties.Title: Freedom In Curriculum

PolicyProperties.Description: The Grand National Assembly aims to stimulate job opportunities, alleviate the economic burden on the low-income bracket, and enhance inter-regional activity. Section I of the C.M.A. of 57' introduces subsidies for all forms of public transport within Sordland, funded by the state. This act enables all citizens to access public transportation services such as buses, trams, trains, and ferries completely free of charge, fostering greater mobility and connectivity. Section II of the act exempts luxury first-class options from the subsidy, ensuring sustainability and responsible use of public resources.
PolicyProperties.Title: Citizen Mobility Act

PolicyProperties.Description: To address healthcare challenges and improve services, the government has proposed a health privatization plan. This plan enables private investors to build or acquire hospitals, thereby expanding healthcare infrastructure and increasing the availability of medical services. The aim is to attract private investment and enhance the overall quality and accessibility of healthcare in Sordland.
PolicyProperties.Title: Health Privatization

PolicyProperties.Description: A comprehensive health reform has been implemented to enhance healthcare services and ensure access to free care for citizens in need. This reform seeks to address existing gaps, improve healthcare delivery, and enhance the well-being of the population. The increased budget allocation for healthcare provides new economic opportunities for improving care and expanding healthcare programs and initiatives.
PolicyProperties.Title: Health Reform

PolicyProperties.Description: The allocation for education has received an increase in funding, presenting new opportunities for enhancements within the education system. This additional budget aims to support the development of educational resources and improvements in the learning environment, ensuring a better educational experience for students.
PolicyProperties.Title: Increased Education Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: The healthcare sector has witnessed an augmented budget, opening up avenues for economic growth and improvements in healthcare services. The increased funding is intended to enhance the quality and accessibility of healthcare for the population of Sordland, leading to better healthcare outcomes and services.
PolicyProperties.Title: Increased Health Funding

PolicyProperties.Description: Sordland has implemented a comprehensive mandatory vaccination policy in the healthcare system. This policy ensures that every individual, including children and adults, receives the necessary vaccinations in alignment with healthcare guidelines, safeguarding public health and preventing the spread of diseases.
PolicyProperties.Title: Mandatory Vaccination

PolicyProperties.Description: To expand on the social benefits initiative set forth by the commission of social progress and uplift, the parliament passes the Comprehensive Family Assistance Act (C.F.A.) with the following laws. Section I introduces a provision where the state issues a fixed payment to parents not in the medium or high-income bracket for every individual child. This measure aims to provide financial support to families facing economic challenges. In Section II, the act unlocks state support specifically targeted at the children of unemployed families, ensuring access to education and addressing any special healthcare needs that may arise. These legislative efforts seek to enhance social welfare and uplift the well-being of vulnerable segments of society.
PolicyProperties.Title: Children Benefits

PolicyProperties.Description: The longstanding welfare principles that have traditionally guided the provision of welfare services by the Renan Aristocracy are currently under scrutiny and evaluation. These principles, which have shaped welfare practices for a significant duration, are being critically assessed to determine their effectiveness and relevance in meeting the evolving needs of the population.
PolicyProperties.Title: Renan Welfare Principles

PolicyProperties.Description: The government of Sordland has a traditional education system, which has been characterized by the promotion of a nationalistic identity and limited intellectual freedom.
PolicyProperties.Title: Traditional Education

PolicyProperties.Description: For an extended period, Sordland has upheld a voluntary vaccination policy, allowing individuals to exercise their freedom of choice regarding vaccination for themselves and their children. This policy has granted citizens the autonomy to decide whether to receive vaccinations, based on personal beliefs and preferences.
PolicyProperties.Title: Voluntary Vaccination
